preamble: Clean, quiet game-interface texture art for a fantasy grand-strategy game, painted but restrained: matte surfaces, very fine and low-contrast material texture visible only at close view, flat even diffuse light, every plate lit uniformly from edge to edge with no vignette, no gradient, no glare, no darker or lighter corners, no wear marks, no stains. The Chancery: the old, calm court. Dark oiled walnut (#2D1D13) with a very fine straight grain of low contrast, one cast-bronze moulding (#634027, lit edge #E0AB6D) with tiny gilt corner leaves and small green inset stones, cream vellum (#E4D7C2) reading surfaces.
tail: No cast shadows outside the plates, no text, no letters, no numbers, no runes, no figures, no faces, no animal heads, no crosses, no sun discs, no skulls, no crowns, no modern objects. No signature or maker's mark. The corners and the bottom edge of the image hold only the plain black ground.
layoutNote: Every cell is one flat rectangular plate seen straight on, filling its own cell edge to edge as a full-bleed square swatch, all cells the same size, separated by narrow black gutters. Any rim or frame of a plate runs straight along its four sides at an even width, with its corner ornament kept inside the rim width; the body inside the rim is one plain, uniform, seamless surface with no motif, so it can be tiled.

a plain swatch of dark walnut, uniform fine grain, with no border and no moulding at all

a plain swatch of cream vellum, uniform, with no edge at all
